meta.note: brand-* values are the site's existing tokens, unchanged. Cream, parchment, gold, bronze and the drop tints are new; gold is sampled from the logo's drop.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page ground on every page (the site's --color-surface). ink 13.8:1, body 11.0:1, secondary 5.4:1, brand 6.2:1, bronze 5.4:1 on it.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Alternate section band, and the stage behind a hero drop. ink 12.4:1, body 10.0:1, secondary 4.8:1, brand 5.6:1, bronze 4.8:1 on it.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, spec tables, form fields and menus on cream or parchment. ink 14.6:1, body 11.7:1, secondary 5.7:1, brand 6.6:1 on it.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Dark band: documents card, closing call-to-action band, footer strip, ad grounds. on-deep 13.8:1, on-deep-secondary 9.5:1, accent 7.6:1, gold 7.0:1 on it. Same value as the site's brand-deep.

tokens.name: deep-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surface inside a dark band, and the pressed state of a brand button. on-deep 9.5:1, on-deep-secondary 6.6:1, accent 5.2:1, gold 4.8:1 on it. Same value as the site's brand-dark.

tokens.name: deep-field
tokens.usage: Form field fill on deep. on-deep text 11.3:1, on-deep-secondary placeholders 7.8:1.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of floating chrome only (product local nav, phone action bar, desktop WhatsApp button), over a 24px backdrop blur. Becomes opaque cream under reduced transparency or increased contrast. Never on content.

tokens.name: deep-glass
tokens.usage: The phone action bar over the home film, which spends most of its length on deep. Over cream it settles near #51675d (on-deep 5.8:1). Becomes opaque deep under reduced transparency or increased contrast. Never on content.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on cream (13.8:1), parchment (12.4:1) and paper (14.6:1).

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Body copy on cream (11.0:1), parchment (10.0:1) and paper (11.7:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, spec labels, captions and section eyebrows on cream (5.4:1), parchment (4.8:1), paper (5.7:1) and brand-tint (4.9:1).

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on deep (13.8:1), deep-raised (9.5:1) and deep-field (11.3:1). Also the fill of the primary button on a dark band, with deep text on it.

tokens.name: on-deep-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and placeholders on deep (9.5:1), deep-raised (6.6:1) and deep-field (7.8:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary button fill, links, selected chips, focus ring on light grounds. As text: 6.2:1 on cream, 6.6:1 on paper, 5.6:1 on parchment. Logo green; the site's brand token, unchanged.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a brand button (white label 10.1:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a brand fill (6.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet background behind brand text (5.7:1) or secondary text (4.9:1), e.g. a selected list row. The site's brand-light, unchanged.

tokens.name: brand-muted
tokens.usage: Decorative only: 3.0:1 on cream, below the text floor. The site's brand-muted, unchanged; never use it for small text again.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Means live, active or done: status dots, success ticks, and the focus ring on dark grounds. As text only on deep (7.6:1) or deep-raised (5.2:1); on cream it is 1.8:1, so there it is a fill with on-accent text. The site's brand-accent, unchanged.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (7.6:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Means the product: drop liquid, grade-chip fill, the hairline under a product name, ad highlights. Sampled from the logo's drop. Text only on deep (7.0:1) or deep-raised (4.8:1); 2.0:1 on cream, so never text there.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: The bright band of the gold liquid. Text on deep 10.0:1, on deep-raised 6.9:1; ink on it 10.0:1.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: The base of the gold liquid. Decorative (4.2:1 on cream).

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Gold-family text on light grounds: grade codes, product eyebrows, ad sub-lines. 5.4:1 on cream, 5.7:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on parchment.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill, e.g. the grade chip (7.0:1).

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Mid-tone of the drop's metal cap. Decorative.

tokens.name: chrome-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the drop's metal cap. Decorative.

tokens.name: chrome-dark
tokens.usage: The drop's tip. Decorative.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers on cream and paper (spec-table rules, card edges). Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control: inputs, outline buttons, filter chips. 3.5:1 on paper, 3.3:1 on cream.

tokens.name: line-on-deep
tokens.usage: Field and outline-button edges on dark grounds: 3.2:1 on deep-field, 3.9:1 on deep.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, always with an icon and words: field messages and invalid borders. 6.5:1 on paper, 6.2:1 on cream, 5.6:1 on danger-tint.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner, with danger text.

tokens.name: danger-on-deep
tokens.usage: Error text on deep (8.6:1).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a notice, e.g. 'catalog temporarily unavailable'.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on warning-tint (7.1:1).

tokens.name: drop-gold
tokens.usage: Liquid mid-tone for Base Oil SN500, and the fallback for any product without its own tint. Illustrative, not a colour specification.

tokens.name: drop-gold-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the gold liquid.

tokens.name: drop-gold-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the gold liquid.

tokens.name: drop-straw
tokens.usage: Liquid mid-tone for Base Oil SN150, paler than SN500. Illustrative.

tokens.name: drop-straw-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the straw liquid.

tokens.name: drop-straw-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the straw liquid.

tokens.name: drop-amber
tokens.usage: Liquid mid-tone for Rubber Process Oil. Illustrative.

tokens.name: drop-amber-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the amber liquid.

tokens.name: drop-amber-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the amber liquid.

tokens.name: drop-brown
tokens.usage: Liquid mid-tone for Light Diesel Oil. Illustrative.

tokens.name: drop-brown-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the brown liquid.

tokens.name: drop-brown-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the brown liquid.

tokens.name: drop-fuel
tokens.usage: Liquid mid-tone for Industrial Fuel Oil. Illustrative.

tokens.name: drop-fuel-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the fuel liquid.

tokens.name: drop-fuel-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the fuel liquid.

tokens.name: drop-bitumen
tokens.usage: Liquid mid-tone for Paving Bitumen VG-30. Illustrative.

tokens.name: drop-bitumen-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the bitumen liquid.

tokens.name: drop-bitumen-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the bitumen liquid.

tokens.name: drop-clear
tokens.usage: Liquid mid-tone for Mineral Turpentine Oil (water-white). Drawn with the chrome rim so it holds its edge on cream. Illustrative.

tokens.name: drop-clear-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the clear liquid.

tokens.name: drop-clear-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the clear liquid.

tokens.name: drop-white
tokens.usage: Fill for Petroleum Jelly (white). 1.1:1 on cream, so always drawn with the chrome rim. Illustrative.

tokens.name: drop-white-light
tokens.usage: Bright band of the white fill.

tokens.name: drop-white-deep
tokens.usage: Base of the white fill.

styles.usage: Home hero headline, laptop (1024px and up).

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Body copy at both widths.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card descriptions, list rows, form hints.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and field labels, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Typical values, not a guarantee of specification.
styles.usage: Disclaimers, footnotes, legal lines.

styles.name: spec-large

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: radius-full

shadow.note: Two resting elevations plus the floating one. Tinted with deep, never black.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and spec tables at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-raised

tokens.name: shadow-float

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on light grounds: a 2px cream gap, then 2px of solid brand (6.2:1 on cream).

tokens.name: focus-ring-deep
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on dark grounds: a 2px deep gap, then 2px of accent (7.6:1 on deep).
